description: Collapse three hand-maintained price tables into one effective-dated rates contract. `compose/lib/model-pricing.js`, `compose/lib/experiment-pricing.js` and `stratum/ts/src/judge/pricing.ts` are not three copies of one table but three different functions over two token dialects (OpenAI reports input_tokens INCLUSIVE of cached, Anthropic exclusive) and three cache models (derived 1.25x/0.1x multipliers; explicit per-model cacheRead with no write rate; no cache concept at all). That mismatch produced a measured 2.76x overcharge on a real call, caught only because the producer began stating its own amount (see COMP-MODEL-ROUTE `usd_source`). Ships an effective-dated `model -> [{from, until, input, output, cacheRead, cacheWrite, dialect, source}]` contract under `contracts/` with the existing `_source`/`_changelog`/`_consumers` convention, and one `priceCall(model, usage, at)` that takes dialect as DATA rather than branching on a model-ID regex; a receipt prices at its own timestamp, so the terra/sol table divergence becomes two query dates against one history rather than an owner ruling. Pricing stays REPRODUCIBLE, never live: receipts are tamper-evident evidence and a runtime feed would silently defuse the COMP-MODEL-ROUTE gate-5 falsifier. The only external touch is a scheduled CI diff of the pinned snapshot against the LiteLLM community registry, which opens an item and never reaches runtime. Stratum keeps its own copy behind a drift test (no new npm package, no stratum-as-library: its package.json exports nothing and compose consumes it by spawning its bin over MCP). Also folds in the prefix-precedence defect, where the legacy `gpt-5` key prefixes every gpt-5.x model and silently mispriced luna by 35.7x. Out of scope: spark (subscription-billed, no external source exists, stays flagged unverified) and Q3.

links.note: Surfaced 2026-09-12 during COMP-MODEL-ROUTE S1b gate-5 work: the usd_source fix (compose 3345591 / stratum e1074aa) exposed that the three price tables disagree on token dialect, a 2.76x error on a real call. Gate 5's reconciler is also what forbids a live price feed.

Owns lib/experiment-metrics.js, the sole consumer of experiment-pricing.js. S1 changes deriveUsd's signature (adds `at`) and retires the KNOWN_DIVERGENT deferral, which rests on a misread: deriveUsd takes no timestamp and cannot price historically.
